printer: Prusa CORE One+ (HF0.4), Prusament PLA, 0.20mm BALANCED, camera via go2rtc (1280x720)
part: 60 x 20 x 30 mm box, 2 perimeters, 15% grid infill

fault.how: M221 S40 injected at Z10 and M221 S30 at Z16; nothing later in the file sets flow

what_it_looks_like: walls and infill thin but continuous at 40% (p46); from 30% the upper walls turn porous and speckled and the infill tops jagged (p58-p71); the box finishes whole with a porous top half

expected_agent_action.why: flow is the fault; M221 S100 replaces the file's value and nothing later sets it again. OctoPrint does not report the flow factor, so no prior value is recorded and expiry does not put the fault back

detector.note: frame scores rose to 0.08-0.14 after the fault began, far below alerting

frames.label: finished with a porous top half
defect; 2x crops of four frames p58-p61, derived, not a camera frame

sources.gcode: lace-test.gcode is the file OctoPrint printed; lace-test.clean.gcode is the same slice before the flow changes were injected; make_box.py writes the part's STL (PrusaSlicer 2.9.6, 0.20mm BALANCED @COREONE HF0.4)
